record.paper_title: Open questions in descriptive set theory and dynamical systems
record.context_brief: Flip conjugacy on Cantor minimal systems
record.original_question: Is the topological flip-conjugacy relation on the class of all Cantor minimal systems a Borel equivalence relation?

evidence.quote: Question 1.7 (Gao). Is the topological flip conjugacy relation for all Cantor minimal systems Borel?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ denote the Cantor space (the unique up to homeomorphism nonempty compact metrizable, perfect, totally disconnected space). A Cantor minimal system is a pair $(K,T)$ where $T:K\to K$ is a homeomorphism such that every $T$-orbit $\{T^n(x):n\in\mathbb{Z}\}$ is dense in $K$. Let $\mathrm{Homeo}(K)$ denote the Polish group of homeomorphisms of $K$ (with the uniform topology), and let $\mathrm{Min}(K)\subseteq\mathrm{Homeo}(K)$ denote the Borel set of minimal homeomorphisms of $K$, regarded as a standard Borel space.

Two Cantor minimal systems $(K,S)$ and $(K,T)$ are said to be flip conjugate if there exists a homeomorphism $h:K\to K$ such that either $h\circ S\circ h^{-1}=T$ or $h\circ S\circ h^{-1}=T^{-1}$. This defines an equivalence relation $E_{\mathrm{flip}}$ on $\mathrm{Min}(K)$.

Question: Is $E_{\mathrm{flip}}$ a Borel subset of $\mathrm{Min}(K)\times\mathrm{Min}(K)$?
artifact.category_tag: Borel equivalence relations in topological dynamics
artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (2024) shows that the topological conjugacy relation on minimal Cantor systems is not Borel, and in fact not classifiable by countable structures; the same arguments apply to flip conjugacy, so the answer to the question is negative. This is established in work of Li–Peng (arXiv:2401.11310) on pointed minimal systems and in the work referenced as DGKKK/DGRK+24 on minimal Cantor systems.

status_evidence.title: Isomorphism of pointed minimal systems is not classifiable by countable structures
status_evidence.snippet: The topological conjugacy relations both for minimal systems and pointed minimal systems are not Borel-reducible to any Borel S_infty-action.
status_evidence.claim: Topological conjugacy of minimal Cantor systems is not Borel (not classifiable by countable structures), implying flip conjugacy is also not Borel.

status_evidence.title: Bowen's Problem 32 and the conjugacy problem for systems with specification
status_evidence.snippet: For minimal Cantor systems it is shown in [DGRK+24] that the conjugacy relation is not Borel.
status_evidence.claim: The conjugacy relation on minimal Cantor systems is known not to be Borel.
